lifecycle.engage: BossAI engage, encounter frame engage, parasite world state reset, combat phase; heroic summons Nefarian.
lifecycle.mangle_to_impale: Mangle cancels projectile/Spew; Crash ejects pincer passengers; both hook auras trigger ACTION_IMPALE_MAGMAW; head is exposed after the impale sequence.
lifecycle.evade: FAIL; eject boss/pincers; remove Parasite Infection/Vomit; despawn head/summons/Nefarian; instance removes Crash dummies and room stalkers.
lifecycle.death: Remove parasite auras, disengage encounter frames, tell Nefarian to finish, call BossAI::_JustDied; instance DONE cleanup and generic Nefarius progression notification.
lifecycle.retail_credit_status: Repository state/credit audited; 10N loot and the Parasite Evening achievement compared with Wowhead Cataclysm Classic on 2026-09-30 (one missing quest item, Soothsayer's Runes 71716); 25N/10H/25H loot and exact reset persistence remain unresolved.

unresolved.detail: 10N resolved 2026-09-30 from seven T11 10N kills (wcl_magmaw_10n_t11_20260930): Mangle 90.17-90.84 s, Massive Crash begin 8.1-8.5 s after Mangle, first Lava Spew 77690 19.8-24.7 s and repeats 22.7-32.4 s, Pillar of Flame about 32 s and 63-68 s, Spew resuming 3.6-4.4 s and Pillar 7.7-8.5 s after the head is covered (the second Point of Vulnerability 79010 refresh, 30.3-31.2 s after Mangle removal in four of five kills), three-target Magma Spit volleys about 6.5 s apart between them. All fit the native queue (Spit 6 s x4 then Pillar, Spew 19 s then 24 s rescheduling the projectile, Mangle 90 s, prepare +3.5 s, Crash +5 s, cover +3 s Spew and +4 s projectile) within cast-state delays. The 95 s Mangle repeat is supported by DBM and the 25H WCL 95.558 s interval; no 10N kill reached a second Mangle. Open: 25-player and heroic timers (Blazing Inferno, Shadow Breath) against target-era logs.

Pinned client/native period, duration and extra-initial flag derive 9 uninterrupted summons. 10N resolved: 9 per Pillar in MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ-22, RtPXnbZxFkpacw1h-6 and Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-22; the other T11 kills list 11-22 damaged parasites over 2-3 Pillars, a lower bound because the damage-done selector lists only damaged units and WCL logs no summon events. No 10N Pillar overlaps the impale (Pillars at about 32, 63-68 and 152-155 s; impale about 106-117 s), so the native 78006 interruption never arises in 10N. Native two-pincer topology; the 4.4.2 client rows (client_442_magmaw_spell_rows_20260930) give both Launch Hook auras 77917/77941 a 3000 ms duration with no cast time, and the native script impales when both are on the spike at once, so the server tolerance is that 3 s overlap; guide <1 s is coordination advice. 10N resolved with current Wowhead/Icy Veins (two riders) plus repository confirmation; WCL exposes no hook, impale or vehicle events in nine 10N kills, so arrival/expiry is a live acceptance observation. Open for 25-player modes: Warcraft Tavern/old Icy Veins describe three riders.
